author: claude-code
idea: manage_coordination.py checkout --mission <ID> edits the mission manifest (status IN_PROGRESS, assignee, worktree) in the directory it is run from (the main tree), not in the new worktree. The main tree is left dirty and the edit collides with the mission PR's own change to the same file (git pull --ff-only aborts). Fix: write the status change into the worktree copy (or skip it), and make checkin finalise or revert it. Seen on MISSION-027.
